$description: Borealis design tokens (Design Tokens Community Group format). Source for the Phase 2 token pipeline (ADR 0044). Dark only for 1.0 (ADR 0052). Surfaces, ink and status colours come from the LuminalShine Mission Control web UI; the gold accent family is replaced by violet. Alpha colours use 8-digit hex (#RRGGBBAA). Dimensions use the Android units dp and sp, which the token pipeline maps for Compose.

surface-raised.$description: Keys, popovers, elements on a surface

line-strong.$description: Input and button border, white at 12%

hover.$description: Row and button hover, white at 4%

scrim.$description: Behind dialogs and sheets, page at 72%

ink-4.$description: Hints and kickers. Mission Control uses #6F757C, raised to pass 4.5:1 on page and surface; use ink-3 on surface-raised

accent-soft.$description: Focus outline on TV and gamepad, accent text on dark overlays

accent-strong.$description: Accent borders and fills that carry no text

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent fills

accent-tint.$description: Selected rows, chips, focused rows, accent at 13%

accent-line.$description: Accent tag and chip borders, accent at 40%

success.$description: Status dot and fills: online, done

warning.$description: Status dot and fills: needs attention

danger.$description: Status dot and fills: failure, destructive

minimum.$description: No text smaller than this on a TV

sheet.$description: Top corners of a bottom sheet

unit.$description: Base unit for layout rhythm; gutters and paddings use 2dp steps

outline.$description: accent-soft outline on the focused element (TV, gamepad)

tile-scale.$description: Scale of a focused cover tile
